text:
maria_support: Hey team, pinging because Acme reported intermittent 400s from embeddings client. They say sometimes embeddings are 384 dims, sometimes 768, client errors on decode. Repro steps attached.

carson_support: customer said it started after they enabled "prefetch" and set prefix "acme-prod-2026". They batch size=8, model="embed-ada-384" via API. Provided request_id samples: req_64a1, req_64a2

maria_support: paste customer curl & python snippet:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n -d '{"model":"embed-ada-384","input":["a","b"],"prefix":"tenant:acme-prod"}'
```

```py
r = client.embeddings.create(model="embed-ada-384", input=batch, prefix="tenant:acme-prod")
```

maria_support: customer logs:

```
2026-03-05T14:32:10Z req=req_64a1 model=embed-ada-384 cache=HIT dim=768
2026-03-05T14:32:10Z req=req_64a1 resp_ok=false err="dimension_mismatch expected=384 got=768"
```

aj_sre: whoa cache HIT with wrong dim. Does cache key include model version? Our key convention is tenant+prefix+hash(input) but not model version in some older code paths.

devon_ml: That explains it. We recently rolled "smart-routing/v2" that will fallback to larger model if capacity low, but prefetch service warms cache uninstrumented with whichever model was available. So I think prefetch + routing leads to key reuse across model variants.

maria_support: customer also saw billing spike, multiple charged tokens because embedding generation retried. They disabled prefetch -> problem stopped.

aj_sre: Need repro. devon, can you reproduce with local sim? Suggests a quick test: send two concurrent requests same prefix but modelA (384) and modelB (768), with prefetch enabled.

devon_ml: I reproduced. Minimal steps:

1) enable prefetch for prefix "repro-tenant"
2) send request A model=embed-ada-384 batch size=1
3) simultaneously force routing to embed-lrg-768 for second request by setting header X-force-model: embed-lrg-768
4) observe cache HIT with wrong dim.

Attached logs and a short test script:

```bash
# repro.sh
for i in 1 2; do
  curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"embed-ada-384","input":["x"],"prefix":"repro-tenant"}' &
  curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H 'X-Force-Model: embed-lrg-768' -d '{"model":"embed-lrg-768","input":["x"],"prefix":"repro-tenant"}' &
done
wait
```

aj_sre: Thanks. Proposed immediate mitigation: set feature flag `embed_cache.strict_keying=true` to include model and model_variant in cache key. Also disable external prefetch for shared prefixes until patch.

carson_support: I'll tell customer to disable prefetch and we'll roll the flag. Any ETA?

devon_ml: Can ship hotfix to include model in key within 4 hours, but need QA for rollout to Dedicated. For hosted, we can flip flag in prod config within 30 min.

maria_support: Noted. I'll update Acme and ask for confirmation after disabling prefetch. Also logging: record request_id and cache_key for follow-up.

aj_sre: Filed ISSUE-RED-5423 and linked config change. :+1:

deploybot: Deploy queued: feature-toggle embed_cache.strict_keying -> ON (canary) at 2026-03-05T18:10:00Z

carson_support: Customer confirmed disabling prefetch removed errors. :tada:
